description: Get the planned routes for one date: per driver/vehicle the duration, distance, loads and the ordered list of stops with scheduled times. Optionally filter to one driver or vehicle and include the encoded polyline, start/end locations and dispatch status. OptimoRoute: GET /get_routes.

includeDispatchStatus.description: Include whether each route was sent to its driver, and changed since.

includeRouteStartEnd.description: Include each route's start and end locations.

name: optimoroute_get_routes
title: Get routes for a date
